answer_2.quote: For semantic accuracy, we use WER, and for sound quality, we employ the Extended Short-Time Objective Intelligibility (ESTOI). Synchronization is measured using LSE-D (predicted audio-video temporal distance) and LSE-C (prediction confidence)... We also use BLEU to evaluate the accuracy and fluency of speech generation in different languages, and we use the Mean Opinion Score (MOS) for evaluating timbre.

answer_4.quote: We use the Mean Opinion Score (MOS) for evaluating timbre. To ensure consistency with other studies, we adopted a scoring system ranging from 1 to 5, with increments of 0.5 points. For each model, we randomly selected 50 samples for evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Raters were asked to assign a MOS rating from 1 to 5 (in 0.5 increments) to assess the timbre quality of the synthesized speech.
